items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: a good tuba player like Poto

ctx.x: It sounds simple when you just sing that little part, but it really fills things out. That's right, sure.

It's great. That helps. My aim of life was to have a band that's for one Sunday show. I could go on the street just a while with a good alto and baritone player, but you can't find them. The boy played a good alto and he was out of his mind today, I guess. I mean, that's the time Alexander, Adolf Alexander, he's not well born. I mean, he was examining the brain. I mean, he was in the hospital a long time. He shot. He hadn't got no alto player. I mean, Pichon was about the only one, I mean, I would pick up the…
Is that the Porter you're speaking of?
